In your opinion whats the best software for monitoring thing like frame rate, temps, fan speed, clock speed etc etc
Fps I use fraps. Monitoring fans I use the corsait software for the h100i and have a manual switch for my case fans. Clock speed cpuz.

I'm right there with you. Though, monitoring my rig isn't too big of a deal. I have roughly 6 fans, water cooling, full ATX Tower. I even have an app from my Logitech Orion that monitors usage if I need it.
I've been using CoreTemp for years. Does the job pretty well and I have no complains.
MSI Afterburner. Does pretty much everything gamer would want out of monitoring software. Including OC and gameplay recording. Has customizable OSD.
I've used HWInfo in combination with Riva Tuner Statistics Server to provide an overlay while playing games. You can set which info you want displayed as well as the position of the overlay.

frame rate - MSI Afterburner

temps - MSI Afterburner, RealTemp

fan speed - my ears/the bios/uefi hw monitoring tab

clock speed - assume it's at max for whatever you clocked it to in the bios/CPUID/MSI Afterburner

etc - windows task manager, NetMeter

MSI Afterburner for GPU stuff and SpeedFan for fan regulation.
